name: Jenkins
description: Jenkins is the leading open source automation server. It provides hundreds of plugins to support building, deploying and automating any project. This package runs the Alpine-based LTS image with a strict memory ceiling so it stays predictable on small servers: the Java heap, the container memory limit and the memory reservation are all configurable before install.
short_desc: The leading open source automation server.
author: Jenkins project

form_fields.label: Container memory limit (MB)
form_fields.hint: Hard ceiling enforced by Docker on the whole container. Keep it comfortably above the max heap, the JVM needs headroom for metaspace, threads and buffers. Default 1024.

form_fields.label: Container memory reservation (MB)
form_fields.hint: Soft floor Docker keeps available for Jenkins under memory pressure. Default 256.

form_fields.label: Java max heap -Xmx (MB)
form_fields.hint: Upper bound of the Java heap. Set this to roughly half the container memory limit so the JVM overhead still fits. Default 512.

form_fields.label: Java initial heap -Xms (MB)
form_fields.hint: Heap allocated at startup. Must not exceed the max heap. Default 256.

form_fields.label: Run the setup wizard on first start
form_fields.hint: Leave enabled for the normal guided setup. The initial admin password is printed in the app logs.

form_fields.label: Inbound agent port
form_fields.hint: Port used by inbound (JNLP) build agents. Only matters if you attach external agents. Default 50000.

form_fields.label: URL prefix
form_fields.hint: Optional. Serve Jenkins from a sub-path, for example /jenkins. Leave empty to serve from the root.

form_fields.label: Extra JAVA_OPTS
form_fields.hint: Optional. Appended verbatim to JENKINS_JAVA_OPTS. Note that -XX:MaxRAMPercentage only takes effect if you also clear the max heap field, since an explicit -Xmx overrides it.
